_readme: PROVEN LOW-COST roster — every generative slot on models that have actually passed this factory's gates.
Copy this object's 'roles' over factory.config.json's 'roles' to activate.
Philosophy (law 10): gates guarantee quality, so every role runs the cheapest thing that clears them.
Director stays premium: runs ONCE per client, ~$1, and every downstream dollar depends on it.
Copygate is a DIFFERENT vendor than copy (independence rule). Gauntlet critic/repair remain Claude (vision).
Derived from Mahdin's Config C (2026-07-27) with its two bugs fixed: per-role fallbacks, cross-vendor copygate.
